answer: Each identity must hold a registered physiotherapist licence: a physiotherapy degree, a supervised clinical placement, and a board exam, one licence per person. No one can hide fakes in a timber vault of records, since every licence needs its own degree and placement. A licence costs about $250, so ten fakes cost $2,500 and ten placements; each extra fake adds $250 more, and the register is an oasis of verified identities where any duplicate stands out.
